sources.label: CoW Bring Your Own Solver staging receipt

cells.text: Pools, intents, solvers, routers and fillers
cells.note: Role in the SEC order: conditional candidate

cells.text: Uniswap introduced permissioned v4 pools for regulated assets, while CoW's Bring Your Own Solver work reached a BNB staging settlement environment by September 25.
cells.detail: Where the proof stops: A generalized hook standard and staging solver receipt do not establish a production regulated market, lawful venue or dependable liquidity for a named security.

cells.text: Applications + AMM (capability); Liquidity provider (candidate); Interoperability + services (support)
items: Applications + AMM · Pool / pricing logic, Router / solver, Code control: The family broadens the application layer beyond one AMM curve.

Liquidity provider · Named Covered Firm, Inventory + hedge, Economics + custody boundary: Solvers and fillers may source liquidity or use inventory, but the exact legal actor and statutory conditions must be proven separately.
Interoperability + services · Messaging / bridge: Cross-chain designs add settlement-oracle and bridge dependencies.

cells.text: Execution software does not supply the TSV operator, participant eligibility, securities rights, Covered Firm status, surveillance, clearing or cash finality. A filler is not automatically the order's qualifying liquidity provider.
cells.note: Watch: Exact public code, contract addresses, permissioning wrapper, pool assets, parameter and pause authority, filler identity, inventory source and execution receipts.
